name: Shadows of the past
source:
In a small town, private detective Josh Wilson leads a quiet and measured life, solving small problems for the locals. But everything changes when Ellie shows up on his office doorstep....

Wrapped up in the investigation, Josh realizes that the small town harbors dark secrets, and the shadows of the past persistently haunt him at every turn. The local police seem adept at covering up the mysterious crimes. But can they stop Josh and Ellie's determination to uncover the truth?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2544010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一个小镇上，私家侦探乔什·威尔逊过着安静而有节制的生活，为当地人解决小问题。但当艾莉出现在他办公室门口时，一切都改变了……

在调查的过程中，乔什意识到这座小镇隐藏着黑暗的秘密，过去的阴影时刻困扰着他。当地警方似乎很擅长掩盖这些神秘的犯罪行为。但他们能阻止乔什和艾莉揭露真相的决心吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2544010/]Steam[/url]]
